item.title: Éliane Radigue has Died, Aged 94
item.description: No cause of death has been disclosed Éliane Radigue, the French composer and pioneer of musique concrète, has died at the age of 94. INA GRM, the Paris-based experimental music institute, broke the news on social media, writing: "It's with immense sadness that we learn of the passing of Éliane Radigue at the age of 94.
